arms.cf-high: same native bank plus its acquired continuation bank (L_high = native + continuation labels); counterfactual loss
arms.cf-lateocc: BE only: cf-high bank with every eligible/participating/occupied query at KW bound<=12 replaced by the native query
arms.cf-low: smaller native bank plus continuation labels uniformly subsampled to exactly L_low total; counterfactual loss
arms.cf-noforce: BE only: cf-high bank with every forced-participation-of-ineligible-root query replaced by the native query
arms.passive-high: new native bank with L_high native labels; passive loss
arms.passive-low: native bank with L_low native labels; passive loss

config.selection: None. Every arm is evaluated at the a-priori 4000-update milestone (1500 reported as secondary). No checkpoint is chosen with any battery.
